bullets.title: MU: Anthropic deal + DRAM/NAND supercycle thesis builds; PT raises across the street
bullets.body: Micron entered a strategic memory/storage supply agreement with Anthropic and made a strategic investment in Anthropic's Series H round. MS raises FY27 EPS to $21.31 on DRAM ASP +45% and NAND +50%, calling multiyear tightness 'not priced in at 9x forward.' Pre-market MU +5.4%.

bullets.title: SNDK: Over 1/3 of FY27 bits locked under NBM contracts; AI demand lifting NAND in memory hierarchy
bullets.body: MS highlights SNDK has secured long-term 3-5 year NBM agreements covering more than one-third of FY27 bit volume, with cloud becoming its largest end-market. AI demand is pushing NAND higher in the memory hierarchy, supporting durable pricing power.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Nobel laureate John Jumper departs DeepMind for Anthropic; stock -2.4% pre-market
bullets.body: AlphaFold co-creator and 2024 Nobel Prize winner John Jumper is leaving Google DeepMind to join Anthropic, the latest in a string of high-profile AI researcher departures (Noam Shazeer previously went to OpenAI). GOOGL indicated down 2.45% pre-market to ~$359. Citi TMT also flags GOOGL struggling to sell AI coding tools.

bullets.title: NVDA: Custom silicon threat escalates from GOOGL and AMZN; robotics safety platform launched
bullets.body: MS and Citi both flag GOOGL escalating from TPU cloud use to direct external chip sales with financing/partnership support, while AMZN is in talks to sell Trainium4 to third-party data centers with Trainium3 largely sold out — framing these as more direct threats to NVDA's accelerator franchise than prior narratives. Separately, NVDA launched Halos for Robotics, an open full-stack safety system extending its AV safety architecture to physical AI.

bullets.title: INTC: +10% on AAPL foundry partnership; Mizuho raises PT to $135; former Hynix CEO hired for foundry
bullets.body: INTC surged ~10% on news of an Apple partnership for US foundry construction. Mizuho raised PT to $135 from $128, seeing 10-15% advanced packaging market share potential. INTC also hired former Hynix CEO to lead foundry; EMIB advanced packaging flagged as lower cost than TSMC CoWoS-L.

bullets.title: DLR: Citi Buy (PT $226) and KeyBanc both positive on $1.61B transaction spree
bullets.body: DLR announced three deals totaling ~$1.61B: a 1,440-acre Kansas City site (~$475M, 600MW scaling to 2GW by 2028), increasing Teraco stake to 77% (~$650M), and acquiring Columbia Capital's $9B AUM platform (~$485M). Funded via 6.3M share issuance at $197.54 plus ~$365M cash. Citi maintains Buy at $226 (22.7% total return); KeyBanc views Teraco at ~24x TTM FFO as accretive vs DLR's ~28x issuance multiple.

bullets.title: ACN: Negative bookings growth triggers IT Services sector selloff; TD Cowen downgrades
bullets.body: Accenture posted negative bookings growth well below even bearish expectations, dragging the broader IT Services sector: INFY flagged down 10-18%. TD Cowen downgraded ACN (pre-market -1.7%). ACN is down ~59% from its 52-week high with MS noting buyside is now avoiding the entire sector.

bullets.title: MSFT: 20-year 2.67 GW power deal with Chevron (Project Kilby); pivoting AI strategy to multi-model/lower-cost inference
bullets.body: MSFT signed a 20-year gas power deal near Pecos, TX with first power by 2028 at mid-teen returns, de-risking data center power supply. CEO Nadella is also repositioning AI value capture from frontier models toward orchestration and lower-cost inference, exploring hosting DeepSeek despite OpenAI partnership.

bullets.title: META: Contracted ~1.6 GW compute capacity from Crusoe across two data centers
bullets.body: META is under contract for approximately 1.6 GW of computing capacity from Crusoe Energy, incremental to ~4.5 GW in 2026 capacity adds, per MS TMT. This underscores continued hyperscaler capex acceleration.

bullets.title: AVGO: Potential TPU share loss to MediaTek at Google on TPUv9 design
bullets.body: Klein/Bernstein note AVGO faces potential share loss to MediaTek on Google's TPUv9 ('Triggerfish') design — Triggerfish carries 30% higher ASP but lower unit volume (1-2M units vs 4-5M for Humufish). Flagged as meaningful competitive risk within AVGO's custom ASIC franchise.

bullets.title: ONTO: Oppenheimer raises PT to $450 (street high) on Dragonfly G5 ramp and AI packaging share gains
bullets.body: Oppenheimer raised ONTO PT to $450 following Boston management meetings, citing accelerating Dragonfly G5 demand, 2027E revenue/EPS raised ~8%, and share gains in 2.5D packaging and HBM. Trading at ~31x 2027E EPS vs KLAC/CAMT peers at 35-40x; recent ~15% pullback attributed to convertible hedging, viewed as buying opportunity. 2026E revenue growth ~35% YoY.

bullets.title: COHR: JPMorgan NDR takeaways session at 12:15PM today post CEO meetings
bullets.body: JPM analyst Joe Cardoso met with COHR CEO Jim Anderson and IR VP Paul Silverstein June 17-18 in Boston/NYC. NDR takeaway session scheduled for 12:15 PM ET today — watch for any post-meeting color on transceiver demand, InP substrate constraints, and data center optical interconnect outlook.

bullets.title: RBLX: Citi Buy; QTD CCUs +7% YoY but trending toward low-end of $1.55-$1.61B 2Q bookings guide
bullets.body: Citi's Week 25 CCU tracker shows average peak CCUs of 15.3M, down 5% YoY; QTD CCUs up ~7% vs 2Q25. Predicted 2Q26 bookings of $1.57B slightly below guidance midpoint and Visible Alpha consensus of $1.60B. 'Grow a Garden 2' release last week did not arrest the weekly CCU decline.

bullets.title: ROKU/FOX: Fox to acquire Roku for $160/share (~$22B EV) in cash-and-stock deal
bullets.body: Fox Corporation announced a definitive agreement to purchase Roku for $160/share in a cash-and-stock combination valuing the company at approximately $22B enterprise value, per StreetAccount M&A summary.

bullets.title: APP: Citi removes 90-day positive catalyst watch on slowing eCommerce client ramp
bullets.body: Citi's Jason Bazinet removed APP from the positive catalyst watch list after store count declined 2% week-over-week (Hong Kong -13%), citing slower-than-expected ramp of eCommerce clients post-general availability. No rating change noted.

bullets.title: SHOP: +1.5% on TSX; Truist highlights Sidekick AI advances extending tech leadership
bullets.body: SHOP trading up 1.5% to C$153.92 on the TSX mid-morning. Truist morning note highlights Shopify extending competitive leadership with key tech updates including Sidekick AI advances.

bullets.title: HOOD: 50K+ agentic trading accounts in ~3 weeks; ~10% workforce cut announced
bullets.body: Robinhood has attracted over 50,000 customers to its agentic trading accounts approximately three weeks after launch, trading millions daily. Separately, Robinhood announced a ~10% workforce reduction (~290 roles) to accelerate product velocity.

bullets.title: DKNG: Citizens says prediction market opportunity could exceed current market cap; NFL season as catalyst
bullets.body: Citizens Research argues the street is not appropriately valuing DKNG's prediction markets opportunity, noting the TAM could exceed DKNG's current market cap and that the company could route significant volume through its exchange by NFL season. Citi TMT notes DKNG reporting +87% prediction volume with 5x higher World Cup handle vs. 2022.

bullets.title: AAPL/TSLA: Tata Electronics cybersecurity breach; 200K+ component/spec files posted to dark web
bullets.body: Ransomware group World Leaks posted over 200,000 files — including component and specification papers for Apple and Tesla products — following a cybersecurity incident at Tata Electronics, one of Apple's key Indian manufacturing partners. Tata identified the breach a few weeks ago.

bullets.title: GNRC: Hyperscaler demand accelerating; Buy with $338 PT, 2x+ FY28 uplift potential, capacity targeting $3.5-4.5B
bullets.body: Zach AM Attack highlights GNRC with a Buy rating and $338 PT, citing new hyperscaler wins that could drive more than 2x uplift to FY28 estimates. Capacity expansion is targeting $3.5-4.5B in revenue, with the data center generator demand cycle characterized as durable.
